title: Returned Payments on the Buyer's Other Calloway Accounts: Surcharge on the Home Purchase Agreement Returned-Payment Fee
content:
**Desk rule.** A surcharge applies to the Home Purchase Agreement returned-payment fee where the buyer's payments have also come back on other Calloway accounts in the same twelve months, that is the twelve months up to the date the fee is charged. The accounts read are the buyer's Homesite Reservation ledger and the buyer's Design Studio Selections (Design Studio) ledger, each for returned-payment entries:

- where the buyer's Homesite Reservation ledger and the buyer's Design Studio ledger **each** show a returned payment in that period, **30.00** is added;
- where **only one** of them shows a returned payment in that period, **15.00** is added;
- otherwise nothing is added.

## Judgement table

| Homesite Reservation ledger: returned payment in the twelve months | Design Studio Selections ledger: returned payment in the twelve months | Added to the returned-payment fee |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 30.00 |
| Yes | No | 15.00 |
| No | Yes | 15.00 |
| No | No | Nothing |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical buyers)

- A buyer whose Homesite Reservation ledger shows two returned payments in the period and whose Design Studio ledger shows none: only one of the ledgers shows a return, so 15.00 is added. The number of returns on a ledger does not change the amount.
- A buyer with a Design Studio return fourteen months before the fee date and a Homesite Reservation return two months before it: only the Homesite Reservation return falls in the period, so 15.00 is added.
- A buyer with no Homesite Reservation and no Design Studio Selections file: nothing is added.
